Lena: AcmeHealth POC passed tech review. Procurement sent PO + two redlines: (1) BYOK/HSM language in DPA, (2) billing Net60 vs our Net30. Also they want a single signed PDF attached to PO.

Lena: Looping in @Carlos and @Priya to advise on DPA redline and signature routing.

Carlos (Legal): If they require customer-only key custody we need a short addendum. Drafting clause: `Customer retains sole custody of encryption keys; Redwood will not persist key material and will provide audit logs on request.` Also note liability cap ask; proposing standard cap with carveout for gross negligence.

Priya (Procurement): Billing email billing@acmehealth.com. They prefer Net60 but can accept Net30 if we agree to milestone invoicing. They will provide PO# AH-2024-321. Their AP system needs a single PDF; DocuSign metadata is rejected.

Omar (Solutions): Order form snippet for network/KMS added: `Private VPC peering, BYOK supported (cloud HSM or on-prem), cloud audit export to customer S3`. If on-prem HSM required, add PS item.

Dev (Eng): We support AWS CloudHSM / Azure HSM (FIPS 140-2). On-prem requires 16-32hrs PS.

SalesOps Bot: DocuSign envelope failed: recipient auth mismatch. Manual envelope env-1724123456-manual created.

Lena: Action items: Carlos finalize DPA addendum by EOD, Priya confirm PO + W-9, Omar add PS line to order form, Dev estimate hours. I will prepare single PDF for AP. Target countersign tomorrow.

Priya (Procurement): I'll push AP to accept Net30 milestone plan and request signed PDFs tonight.

Carlos (Legal): Uploaded redline `acme_dpa_addendum_1724123456.pdf` with BYOK clause.

Lena: Thanks team ":thumbsup:" — ping me if blockers.
